value.signature: fn bind_procedure < 'a > (state : & 'a CompiledState , procedure : Procedure , verifier : & impl ProcedureVerifier , limits : Limits ,) -> Result < BoundProcedure < 'a > , ProcedureError >

review.body: { let inputs = state . package () . input () . inputs . last () . ok_or (ProcedureError :: Binding) ? ; if procedure . boundary != inputs . parameters () . boundary || procedure . edition != inputs . parameters () . edition || procedure . name != inputs . constants () . content () . numerical_procedure { return Err (ProcedureError :: Binding) ; } validate_procedure (& procedure , limits . clone ()) ? ; wall_range (state , & procedure , limits) ? ; if ! verifier . published_procedure (& procedure) { return Err (ProcedureError :: Publication) ; } Ok (BoundProcedure { state , procedure , enclosed_wall : None , }) }
review.item_premise: The entire public input and consistency outcome is recorded, or inherited by immutable access from the binding operation.
